intro: Tourism, skiing and shopping drive Andorra's economy.

chapters.title: Skiing and shopping
text: Millions of visitors come each year to ski at resorts such as Grandvalira and to shop, because taxes are low.

chapters.title: Banking
text: Banking is important, though Andorra has worked to shed its image as a tax haven.

keyTerms.meaning: A place with very low taxes that attracts money from abroad.
